title: Formalizing Delcourt–Postle’s refined absorption in Lean
abstract: One assembled Lean formalization of principal refined absorption results and their consequences. The selected results include refined omni-absorbers and refiners, labelled reserve matchings, dense compatible decompositions, an additive compatible-absorber interface retaining independence of the entire old ambient vertex set, and existence of simple designs for every fixed q > r ≥ 2 and index λ ≥ 1 at all sufficiently large admissible orders. The literal global embedding conclusion of the survey is refuted separately from a proved piecewise replacement. The research-note endpoints give completion avoiding an arbitrary forbidden partial Steiner system, sparse prescribed and finite embedded exact intersections, an initial polynomial intersection interval, and polynomial excess in partial parallel classes and Nash–Williams schedule rounds. Both external inputs are supplied by pinned proved theorems. The single comparison selects eighteen declarations from the existing aggregate proof root.
